meta.title: Broadcast / livestream signal flow
meta.description: Starter: broadcast / livestream booth. Three SDI cameras into a switcher, encoder and recorder, a Dante audio feed from FOH, multiview and program monitors, intercom, a PTZ controller and a broadcast rack on a switch with a stream VLAN.

pages.title: Sunday power-up: Broadcast booth
pages.summary: Bring the stream chain up and run the pre-service checks (about 15 minutes, finish 30 minutes before the service).
pages.body:
## 1. Power

- [ ] Check [[device:bcast-ups]] shows mains OK; switch on [[device:bcast-pdu]].
- [ ] Wait for [[device:bcast-sw]] link lights.

## 2. Video

- [ ] Power on [[device:bcast-switcher]]; the multiview on [[device:bcast-multiview]] should show all inputs.
- [ ] Wake the cameras from [[device:bcast-ptz-ctrl]] and recall preset **1** on each ([[device:bcast-cam-1]], [[device:bcast-cam-2]], [[device:bcast-cam-3]]).
- [ ] Open the graphics package on [[device:bcast-gfx-pc]] and confirm input **4 GFX**.

## 3. Audio

- [ ] Confirm FOH feed meters on the switcher (left and right from [[device:bcast-audio-io]]).
- [ ] Talk to FOH on intercom channel A.

## 4. Stream and record

- [ ] Insert a formatted card in [[device:bcast-recorder]].
- [ ] On [[device:bcast-encoder]] start the stream to [[device:bcast-stream]] 10 minutes before; verify the preview on a phone.
